scheduler: all joint optimizer groups multiplied by 0.1 after epoch 10 of round 0, unchanged thereafter
source_sampling: default_rng(seed+global_epoch).permutation(train_size); limited takes first 4864, full takes all; int64 digests; retain full-source final batch of 16
target_sampling: default_rng(seed+10000+global_epoch).permutation(target_size) first 4864; repeat this fixed sequence to match source length, trim final batch to source batch length
pseudo_labels: mean of two target-attention logits, fixed at start of each round, no true target labels
selection: strict maximum source-attention source-validation macro-F1; first tie; also retain fixed epoch-30 final checkpoint
diagnostic_attention: evaluate both attention paths on source validation; target-attention validation does not select checkpoint
limitations: One development fold and one seed, no independent generalization estimate.
Full-source sampling increases optimizer updates, target presentations and scheduler timing in update units; not a pure source-coverage intervention.
Retaining the final source batch changes its size versus limited sampling; paired source-only/ADAST batches remain matched.
Pinned ADAST architecture and harmonized implementation, not exact reproduction of the published dataset protocol.
SHHS has been examined historically; no target-test access or choice in this development attempt.
